Name: Personal Trees
Author: Reprodudix
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/yn82jbfD/personal-trees-1.png[/img][/center]
This mod introduces a tree ownership system, ensuring that only the player who planted a tree can cut it down. Wild trees remain unowned and can be chopped by anyone. A small owner portrait and tooltip will help players identify tree ownership.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]  
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].  
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Optional: Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure mod. You can always change the settings manually by editing the configuration file in the mod directory.
[*]Run the game via SMAPI.  
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]  
[list=1]
[*][b]Tree Ownership System[/b]  
Trees planted by a player are owned by them, preventing other players from cutting them down.  

[*][b]Wild Trees Remain Free[/b]  
Naturally grown trees are unowned and can be cut down by anyone.  

[*][b]Ownership Notification[/b]  
If a non-owner attempts to chop down a tree, a message will notify them of the rightful owner.  

[*][b]Hover to See Owner[/b]  
Placing the cursor over the lower part of a tree will display a tooltip with the owner’s name.  

[*][b]Mini Owner Portrait[/b]  
A small portrait of the tree’s owner appears on the trunk of owned trees.  

[*][b]Toggle Owner Portraits[/b]  
Use the configurable keybind ([b]J[/b] by default) to show or hide owner portraits. Configurable via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] or manually in `config.json`.  

[*][b]Missing Mod Notification[/b]  
If a player joins a multiplayer session without the mod, a chat message will inform others.  
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]  
[list]
[*]Works with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].  
[*]Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.  
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
- Trees planted by players are now owned
- Wild trees remain unowned
- Non-owners get a warning when chopping
- Hover over the base to see the owner’s name
- Mini owner portrait on the trunk (toggle with `J`)
